description: Two jobs: (1) cost adders that feed the total_construction_cost metric (things not in per-part price_usd), and (2) the BALANCE weights that trade the three objective metrics — total_construction_cost, array_area_m2, system_mass_kg — against each other into one selection score used by scripts/rank.py. BMS is now its own part (data/parts/bms.json), so it is NOT a cost rule here.

balance_of_system.definition: Fuses (Class-T + string), DC breakers, disconnects, busbars.

connectors.definition: MC4, lugs, terminal hardware (cable itself is priced by run below).

contingency_factor.definition: Multiplier on (parts + adders + wiring) for misc/small parts/overage.

wiring_copper_cost_per_a_m.definition: Copper cost per amp-meter of DC run (thicker wire for more current). wiring_cost = this x (battery_run_m x load_A + panel_run_m x array_A), currents = power/bus. Lower bus voltage -> higher current -> more copper.

balance.note: score = total_construction_cost + mass_penalty_per_kg * system_mass_kg + area_penalty_per_m2 * array_area_m2 + condition_penalty_per_part * nonworking_count - capacity_bounty_per_kwh * min(battery_extra_kwh, capacity_bounty_cap_kwh). Lower is better. Penalties are cost-equivalent (USD) so all objectives combine into a dollar-denominated score. The bounty is a negative term (credit). Set a weight to 0 to ignore it; raise it to weight it harder.

mass_penalty_per_kg.definition: Cost-equivalent penalty per kg of system mass (portability for a 1-week trip).

area_penalty_per_m2.definition: Cost-equivalent penalty per m2 of panel area (packing bulk + desert wind loading).

condition_penalty_per_part.definition: HEAVY cost-equivalent penalty per selected part that is not in working condition (condition = 'needs-repair'). Demotes salvage/broken parts below any working alternative. Used-but-working parts are NOT penalized.

capacity_bounty_per_kwh.definition: MODEST credit per kWh of usable battery capacity ABOVE the full requirement (battery_extra_kwh = provided - nominal_needed). Rewards cheap headroom: any capacity upgrade whose marginal SCORE cost (cost + mass penalty) is below this rate is selected. On a fixed 48V single string this tips the pick to a bigger cell (e.g. gotion 340Ah -> 17.4 kWh); below ~$55/kWh the mass penalty offsets it and no pick changes. Set to 0 to disable.

capacity_bounty_cap_kwh.definition: Ceiling on the credited extra capacity (~one extra cloudy-day-bridge of energy). Beyond this, more capacity earns no bounty, so the optimizer won't chase a runaway oversized bank.
